overview.description: The CoinShares Bitcoin Mining and Digital Power ETF (WGMI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed ETF investing in companies globally at the intersection of bitcoin mining, artificial intelligence infrastructure, advanced computing, and digital power  targeting businesses considered to be driving the next generation of computational and energy ecosystems. WGMI was launched on Feb 7, 2022 and is issued by CoinShares.
